title: 第七章：少年狂
lines: 第两百二十一章：再入场
贺勇从来都不是一个喜欢说大话的人，如果贺勇这句话实在别人面前说，周不正和孙天阳或许还会去想一下他是不是在吓唬别人，但是这里就他们三个人，不管是周不正还是孙天阳，都不认为贺勇有在他们面前说假话的必要，特别还是在这种特别重要的事情上。
孙天阳和周不正都十分的惊讶，同时也带着些难以置信，他们三人前后突破到武师后期的时间都差不多，都感觉自己距离武师初期只差半步，但是每每一到关键时候，他们却总是捅不破那最后一层窗户纸，虽然心中有些着急，不过好歹大家都一样，也没什么好计较的，但是现在贺勇却告知他们他自己突破在即，这怎么让孙天阳和周不正不惊讶？！
“最近的预感颇为强烈，本来是不怎么确定的，但是见识过白青释放出来的武师初期的气息之后，现在再一一印证我之前的一些推测，所以突破，也就在这几天的时间了，这几天你们别离我太远，也好为我护法，怎么样，二位护法？”
孙天阳和周不正简直不敢相信自己的耳朵，虽然贺勇口中说的是让他们当护法什么的，但实际上恐怕谁都明白他的心思，不过是想让周不正和孙天阳彻底了解的他突破的过程，然后借助他的突破来加快自己突破的速度。
但是这或许能够让他们高兴，但是却不能让他们觉得心惊，更关键的是，如果他们两个人中有任何一个人怀有异样的心思，打断哪怕只是搅扰了贺勇的突破，，那么对贺勇来说都几乎是不可承受的毁灭性的打击，就算是亲兄弟之间，在这种关键的时候都未必信得过，更何况，这个过程中，一旦贺勇因为什么事情分了神或者无法集中精神，那对贺勇来说也是无法进入到突破时的那种玄妙的状态。
而且，如果一个人突破的前后过程被人知道太多的话，就相当于再他人面前彻底的暴露了自己的弱点，一旦被有心人领悟到并且加以利用的话，可以说贺勇这辈子都别想逃出周不正或者孙天阳的手掌心了。
同时周不正和孙天阳也为这份毫无保留的信任所感动，也为贺勇这份魄力所折服，并且心中也是感念贺勇的这种难得的情谊。
“你们觉得我和行天还有回到过去的可能吗？”
贺勇一言问出，孙天阳和周不正两人却都是沉默，不是他们不愿意回答，而是真的不知道该怎么回答他这句话，他们不管是谁其实都知道贺勇这个时候问及这个问题是什么意思，无非是想让方行天也来当他的“护法”，但是他们都还有一件事没有来得及告诉贺勇，所以他们更不知道该怎么说，因为话一旦出口，就再也没有更改的余地了。
周不正撇了撇嘴，他和方行天互看不对眼已经不是一天两天了，这事贺勇是知道的，所以他觉得自己更有保持沉默的全力，也就向孙天阳使了使眼色。
“其实有件事之前没来得及告诉你……”
无奈之下，孙天阳也只能硬着头皮说了，谁让周不正那个家伙脸皮太厚，这种时候也好意思退缩呢。
content_zh:
“你也是这么挨着揍过来的？”其中道理苏馨也是明白，只是关心则乱，更何况涉及到自己的心头肉？经过自己夫君的解说，已经能够接受了，现在听到自己夫君提到这些，不禁有些好奇起来。

    “咳•••咳•••，想当年，我一个打五个，一天打三场，从来就没输过，要不是看那帮小子挨揍挨的可怜，他们能像现在这样活蹦乱跳的？”贺烈满脸不在乎的说道。

    话分两边，不提贺烈夫妇打情骂俏，专讲贺峰带着李纯前去“兄弟盟”找场子。

    其实贺峰能独自一人跟着李纯过来，也并不全是一股热血上脑，一，他确实很生气别人对自己父母的不敬，这是他所不能容忍的；二，他是被李纯说的那句“我是输了，我来就是想问问你，打虎亲兄弟，这个场子，你找不找？！”感动了，一个人在外面受了欺负挨了揍的时候，首先想到的会是谁？当然是自己的兄弟，而李纯没有在外面找帮手，而是来他这里找他做主，这让一世孤独的他很是感动；三，尽管对方人比自己多，也比自己打，但也并不是说自己就一定会输，何况自己也是有备而去。

    说起来，可能会有人嘲笑贺峰感情泛滥或是不懂感情，一世孤苦的贺峰虽然最看重亲情，但最不懂得也是情亲，可以这样说，除了对父母天然的依赖感与守护的欲望，对其他的一切，都只是持有一种无所谓的态度，当然，没有经历过他的那种生活的人，是很难理解他的那种感受的。而当他听到李纯的那句“打虎亲兄弟”以及问他“这个场子，你找不找？”时，他确实愣了一下，他没想到之前李纯对自己之所以有些依赖情绪，是因为把自己看成了亲兄弟，更没想到，李纯虽然口中不停喊自己为二弟，现在却是让自己来为他做主。

    李纯在前面领路，贺峰在后面跟着，同时心中不停地想着怎么让别人按照自己的套路出牌，怎么控制住局面，想着想着，突然觉得这种感觉有些熟悉，猛地一想，这不就像是前世自己的小弟受了欺负，自己跟着去找对头“谈判”吗？一时间竟不觉间笑了出来，不过那时候可是真的打生打死，一言不合，马上白刀子进，红刀子出，而现在却是去跟一帮小孩子玩过家家，不禁有种滑稽的感觉。

    “二弟，二弟，你笑什么？”李纯听到贺峰的笑声，赶紧停了下来问道。

    “啊，没笑什么，赶紧走吧，不然一会人家该等急了。”贺峰有些尴尬的摸了摸鼻子，满脸无所谓的说道，话说这是去打架，不是去约会。

    直到出了镇子，才在前面路旁的一个树林外面看到那些“兄弟盟”的人，见他们好像也正在往镇子里面赶，便在路旁停下等着他们前来。

    谁知道坐在最前方的金宇，也是这六个人里面年龄最小的一见到他们，便马上往回跑，还不停地喊着：“大哥，大哥，那个胖子又来找揍啦，大哥，快来看啊。”

    喊得这么大声，贺峰和李纯当然也听到了，贺峰抽了抽鼻子，有些尴尬的转向李纯问道：“大哥，你能解释一下你到底有多喜欢挨揍吗？”说完，也不等李纯是何反应，径直向着小树林走去，他实在是怕要是再等下去，自己会忍不住笑出来，现在可是在打架，不太适合搞笑。
content_en:
"Did you get beaten up like this?" Su Xin also understood the truth. Just caring about it would lead to chaos, let alone one's own heart and soul?After my husband's explanation, I was able to accept it. Now that I heard my husband mention this, I couldn't help but become curious.

"Cough•••cough•••, I think back then, I fought five against each other, three times a day, and never lost. If it weren't for the pitiful beatings that those guys got, how could they be as active as they are now?" He Lie said with a nonchalant expression.

话分两边，不提贺烈夫妇打情骂俏，专讲贺峰带着李纯前去“兄弟盟”找场子。

In fact, He Feng was able to follow Li Chun here alone, and it was not all a matter of enthusiasm. First, he was really angry at others' disrespect for his parents, which he could not tolerate; second, he was moved by Li Chun's words, "I lost. I came here just to ask you, brothers who fight tigers, are you looking for this place?!" When a person is bullied and beaten outside, who does he think of first?Of course it was his brother, and Li Chun did not look for help outside, but came to him to make the decision, which moved him who had been lonely all his life; thirdly, although the opponent had more people than him and fought better than him, it did not mean that he would definitely lose, not to mention that he was prepared to go.

Speaking of which, some people may laugh at He Feng's overflowing emotions or lack of understanding of emotions. Although He Feng, who has been lonely all his life, values ​​family ties the most, he does not understand them the most. It can be said that except for his natural dependence on his parents and the desire to protect him, he just has an indifferent attitude towards everything else. Of course, it is difficult for people who have not experienced his kind of life to understand his feelings.And when he heard Li Chun's words "brothers who fight tigers" and asked him "Can you find this place?", he was really stunned for a moment. He did not expect that the reason why Li Chun was somewhat dependent on him before was because he regarded him as a biological brother, and he did not expect that although Li Chun kept calling him his second brother, he would now let himself make the decision for him.

Li Chun led the way, and He Feng followed behind. At the same time, he kept thinking about how to make others play according to his own routine and how to control the situation. As he thought about it, he suddenly felt that this feeling was familiar. He suddenly thought, isn't it like his younger brother was bullied in the previous life, and he went to "negotiate" with his opponent?I laughed unconsciously for a moment, but at that time, I was really fighting to death. If I disagreed, a white knife would come in and a red knife would come out. But now I was playing house with a bunch of children. I couldn't help but feel funny.

"Second brother, second brother, why are you laughing?" Li Chun heard He Feng's laughter and quickly stopped and asked.

"Ah, you're not smiling. Let's go quickly, otherwise people will be waiting in a hurry." He Feng touched his nose awkwardly and said nonchalantly, saying that this was a fight, not a date.

直到出了镇子，才在前面路旁的一个树林外面看到那些“兄弟盟”的人，见他们好像也正在往镇子里面赶，便在路旁停下等着他们前来。

谁知道坐在最前方的金宇，也是这六个人里面年龄最小的一见到他们，便马上往回跑，还不停地喊着：“大哥，大哥，那个胖子又来找揍啦，大哥，快来看啊。”

Of course He Feng and Li Chun heard the shouting so loudly. He Feng sniffed, turned to Li Chun with some embarrassment and asked: "Brother, can you explain how much you like to be beaten?" After saying that, he walked straight towards the woods without waiting for Li Chun's reaction. He was really afraid that if he waited any longer, he would not be able to help laughing. He was fighting now, so it was not suitable for comedy.
